name: Improved Quality
summary: At Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider now seeks finer hides from the tougher yetis in Rage Scar Hold.

sections.title: A Tougher Throng of Yetis
sections.body: After The Mark of Quality, Jangdor Swiftstrider has found a better source of hides. Tougher yetis roam inside Rage Scar Hold in northern Feralas. Bring ten hides to Camp Mojache, and Jangdor will pay handsomely. If they match the Feral Scar hides, they may prove as resilient as thorium.

sections.title: Jangdor's Thanks
sections.body: Jangdor Swiftstrider finds the hides better than he hoped. Once properly cured, he can tell they will grow much harder. In thanks, he gives you one of his latest creations.

faq.q: Who asks for the Rage Scar yeti hides?
faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider asks for ten Rage Scar yeti hides at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

faq.q: Where do the Rage Scar yetis live?
aliases: where to get rage scar hides
faq.answer: The Rage Scar yetis live inside Rage Scar Hold, in northern Feralas.
Jangdor Swiftstrider wants ten Rage Scar yeti hides.

aliases: what quest leads to improved quality
faq.answer: It follows The Mark of Quality, when you dealt with the first throng of yetis.
